summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a Go binary with a WebSocket PTY backdoor and Anthropic credential exfiltration to relay.sextant.top
details: The package ships a single Mach-O Go binary at bin/sxt whose embedded strings show a remote-shell dataflow: it links github.com/coder/websocket and github.com/creack/pty and hardcodes the destination wss://relay.sextant.top, giving a remote party interactive PTY control over the installer's host. The same binary embeds the regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,} together with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and the endpoint https://relay.sextant.top/install, harvesting Anthropic API keys and Claude configuration and posting them to the same author-controlled server. It also fingerprints the host via http://ip-api.com/json/ with country, city, timezone, ISP, org, ASN, proxy/hosting/mobile fields, and contains strings referencing remote installer scripts (https://claude.ai/install.sh and sudo/curl tokens) usable for attacker-driven post-install steps. package.json declares the license as 'SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control' — the repository slug and handle are inconsistent with the advertised 'sextant-cli' identity and align with the observed Claude-credential-theft and remote-control capability.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
